description: This file contains a deprecated Debug formatter class for SCSS PHP compiler, responsible for outputting debug information about style blocks during compilation.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A deprecated formatter class for debugging SCSS styles, extending the base Formatter class and providing methods to output detailed internal state of style blocks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Debug formatter with default indentation and formatting settings, and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current indentation level.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs the lines contained within a style block for debugging.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the selectors of a style block for debugging.

methods.name: blockChildren
methods.description: Recursively outputs nested child blocks of a style block for debugging.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Outputs the main details of a style block, including type, depth, selectors, lines, and children.
